units.sourceHTML: 8.5 Saving the Changed File

units.text: Traditional Unix ⟦0⟧ generates an ⟦1⟧ script without the trailing ‘⟦2⟧’ and ‘⟦3⟧’ commands that save the changes. System V ⟦4⟧ generates these extra commands. GNU ⟦5⟧ normally behaves like traditional Unix ⟦6⟧, but with the ⟦7⟧ option it behaves like System V ⟦8⟧ and appends the ‘⟦9⟧’ and ‘⟦10⟧’ commands.
units.sourceHTML: Traditional Unix diff3 generates an ed script without the trailing ‘w’ and ‘q’ commands that save the changes. System V diff3 generates these extra commands. GNU diff3 normally behaves like traditional Unix diff3, but with the -i option it behaves like System V diff3 and appends the ‘w’ and ‘q’ commands.

units.text: The ⟦0⟧ option requires one of the ⟦1⟧ script options ⟦2⟧, and is incompatible with the merged output option ⟦3⟧.
units.sourceHTML: The -i option requires one of the ed script options -AeExX3, and is incompatible with the merged output option -m.

nonProse: Command/flag literals and pure code/output examples retained; explanatory dt labels and italic pre descriptions extracted too; no unhandled prose text.
